title: Corporate Travel Policy
content: Domestic travelers can expense up to 65 dollars per day for meals. Hotel bookings should use the approved travel portal when possible. International travel requires manager approval and a documented business purpose. Receipts are required for hotel, air, and ride-share expenses above 25 dollars.

title: Incident Response Handbook
content: Sev-1 incidents require immediate paging of the on-call engineer and the incident commander. Customer updates should be posted every 30 minutes until mitigation is complete. Post-incident reviews should be drafted within two business days and include timeline, root cause, and follow-up actions.
